summary: Revvity filed an 8-K announcing the probable sale of all assets of its Immunodiagnostics business in China (China IDX) pursuant to a letter of intent signed April 16, 2026. Terms include up to $200 million, subject to adjustments and conditions. Management deems the transaction probable to close in 2027 and includes unaudited pro forma financials. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory approvals and adjustments to the purchase price; risk-arb focuses on execution and closing timeline.
